Game Overview

At its heart, Emotional Support Duck is a casual game about guide your player and their duck through an emotional journey. Balance energy and support while reacting to dynamic events and alerts. Delight in smooth animations and custom synth sounds, progressing with persistent achievements. Confront challenges and outsmart the Bureaucracy Goose to advance. Maintain strength together and succeed!
